description.value: This kit contains portable tools for cybernetic surgery: high precision scalpels, a highly calibrated headset with an augmented HUD for surgery, stasis clamp, stapler, sutures, and a small set of tools specific to cybernetics. Proficiency with this kit lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability check you make that involves cybernetics. Also, proficiency with this kit is required to cyberware from bodies that they are already attached to without risk of damaging either the body or the cyberware.
